thread:
alex_ng: hi team :wave: I started last Monday and had a few quick benefits/payroll onboarding questions — hope this is the right place.
alex_ng: 1) I haven't received my health/benefits card yet — is that mailed? 2) I submitted my tax form but it still says 'pending' in the portal; any ETA? 3) Joined mid-pay-period, how are holidays/pto prorated for this month?
joanne_peopleops: welcome @alex_ng! yep this is the right place. cards are mailed by our vendor and usually arrive in 7-10 business days to the address on file. did you confirm your mailing address in the benefits portal?
alex_ng: I double-checked — address looks correct. employee ID is 73621 (dm'ing full id).
finance-bot: payroll notice: If federal/state tax forms are incomplete, new hire tax calculation defaults to single/0 until processed.
mike_payroll: @alex_ng thanks — I'll look up the tax form status. can you confirm the last 4 of the acct you added for direct deposit? i'll ping payroll ops and update if there's a mismatch.
alex_ng: last 4 are 4321. i uploaded a photo of the voided check earlier.
sarah_benefits: re: holiday/proration — most company-observed holidays are prorated if you start after the payroll cut for that pay period. PTO accrual for new hires is pro-rated based on start date. If you want i can pull exact numbers for March (assuming the pay period that includes your start date).
joanne_peopleops: also to clarify about dependent enrollment deadlines — you have 30 days from your start date to add dependents for benefits to be effective from your hire date. after that it's a qualifying life event.
alex_ng: awesome, thanks all. if the card doesn't show up by end of next week i'll flag here. appreciate the quick help :slightly_smiling_face: 
mike_payroll: noted — i'll follow up with a manual tax reprocess if finance-bot shows still pending tomorrow.
joanne_peopleops: thanks — feel free to DM any docs. tagging @sarah_benefits so she can pull the plan effective dates for you.
sarah_benefits: got it, pulling details now. will post a short follow-up with effective dates and PTO proration math.
alex_ng: thanks :)
